{{Quote|You have to drink Huttese ale fast. Otherwise it eats through the mug.|Filba to Den Dhur|audio=YouHaveToDrinkHutteseAleFast-MedStarI.flac|<ref name="MedStar I" />}}
'''Huttese ale''' was a beverage [[Diet/Legends|drunk]] by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The [[Ale/Legends|ale]] was [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and fizzy, and it was usually served in mugs. However, Huttese ale had to be consumed quickly before it dissolved the mug in which it was served.<ref name="MedStar I" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> [[Filba]], a Hutt [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], drank Huttese ale during his stay at the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. After the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]] commented on how quickly Filba drank the ale, the Hutt explained the need for its quick consumption.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ale appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel of the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''. ''Battle Surgeons'' was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]], and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
